item.text: I’ll refactor only the affected test class, then run its Maven test target if the module setup permits.

The refactor is in place. Maven reached the target test but the environment reported Windows access-denied errors while closing cached dependency JARs; I’m checking the test report and the final diff to distinguish that infrastructure issue from test failures.
